workspaceId.description: Stable identity of the authenticated workspace, preserved through restore.

confirmedCatalogRevision.description: The selected current catalog revision explicitly confirmed by the operator. Required for unidentified deliveries and when an identified delivery recorded an older revision.

backingCurrent.description: False when catalog eligibility or its recorded revision has changed. The internal offer remains unpublished.

asOf.description: Database transaction time for this one-location snapshot.

complete.description: All current placements in the selected location were read.

backing.description: Explicit offer quantities whose sum cannot exceed the physical quantity moved. Supply an empty array when moving all backing or only unbacked units. The authenticated transfer request body limit is 128 MiB.

moveAllBacking.description: Explicitly move all source offer backing. Requires the full physical source quantity and an empty backing array.

backingCurrent.description: False when catalog eligibility or its recorded revision has changed. The internal offer remains unpublished.

receiptQuantity.description: The whole delivery's original quantity, including stock outside this bin.

receiptItemCostMinor.description: Documented acquisition amount for the whole delivery in its purchase currency. Null represents unknown; zero is a documented zero. This is not a bin allocation or unit cost.

complete.description: The requested positions, case summaries and observation page were read successfully. Use nextAfter for additional history.

positionId.description: The exact position scope, including when resolved by a receipt lookup. Null means the selected bin.

nextAfter.description: Pass this observation ID as after for the next history page. Null indicates the end of the scoped history.

closures.description: With closures=true, includes exact-recount closures linked to the observation page or exact observation.

freeQuantity.description: Physical quantity less active build holds and quarantined pieces. Includes existing offer backing. Reading an affected position requires quarantine=true.

availableToHoldQuantity.description: Eligible units excluding holds and offer backing and subject to the shortage fence.

itemCostMinor.description: Original whole-delivery item cost. Zero is documented and null is unknown.

backedQuantity.description: Current backing from this position only.

complete.description: The case and aggregate facts are complete at asOf. Follow nextAfter for more offer rows.

candidateLossQuantity.description: Current ledger minus observed quantity, floored at zero. This read posts no loss.

offerBackedQuantity.description: Sum of current offer backing at this position across all pages.

offerCount.description: Number of offers backed at this position across all pages.

offerCapacityAfterLoss.description: Projected capacity after protecting project units and retained quarantine. Null when an aggregate shortage leaves the missing units' quarantine status unknown.

minimumOfferBackingReduction.description: Minimum reduction across existing offer backing when projected capacity is known. Null when the missing units' quarantine status is unknown.

offerReductions.description: Distinct, positive backing reductions at this position. The total must equal the reviewed minimum.

quarantineAttributions.description: Supply explicitly when active quarantine exists. An empty array confirms zero quarantined units are missing; omitted or null leaves attribution unknown.

complete.description: Posting and aggregate facts are complete. Continue through nextAfter for all reduction rows.

allocatedItemCostMinor.description: Item basis allocated to just this loss; null denotes unknown basis.

remainingDeliveryItemCostMinor.description: Remaining item basis for the whole delivery immediately after this posting.

nextQuarantineAfter.description: Present when another attribution page is available.

backingCurrent.description: True when the offer has remaining backing and its catalog revision is current and eligible. The offer remains unpublished.

occurredAt.description: Original observation or audit timestamp. Null means the event has no recorded timestamp.

quantity.description: The event amount or the witnessed count. Read the three signed deltas for ledger effects.

locationCodeAtEvent.description: Historically recorded bin code, or null if the event did not record one.

complete.description: This page reflects the authoritative recorded events. Follow nextAfter for older rows.

hasUndatedEvents.description: At least one event in the selected position's full retained history lacks a timestamp.

position.description: Current position identity and balances from the same database snapshot as this page.

lostQuantity.description: Quantity consumed by attributed posted losses. Included with lossAttribution=true. Released quantity only counts passed inspection releases.
